title: Open Mapping Theorem for Separable Banach Spaces
exact_target: Determine whether either recursive comprehension alone or weak König's lemma suffices for the open mapping theorem on separable Banach spaces.

sources.citation: ULAM.AI and the UnsolvedMath Contributors, UnsolvedMath: A Curated Collection of Open Mathematics Problems, record 7500204 (AMR-074-0204). CC BY 4.0.
